card.title: Enzymes and vitamins — catalysts and co-factors

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Enzymes are protein catalysts (ribozyme exceptions noted) that cut activation energy via induced-fit active sites — specific, efficient, denaturable by heat/pH. Vitamins are organic co-factors in micro-doses: fat-soluble A/D/E/K stored in liver, water-soluble B-complex/C flushed daily (scurvy, beriberi, rickets mark their absence). Hormones (peptide/steroid/amine) are the body's long-distance signals. Carbohydrate/protein structure foundations carry over from Class 11.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: enzyme: E + S ⇄ ES → E + P (lock-and-key → induced fit)  ·  vitamins: fat-soluble A·D·E·K (stored) · water-soluble B·C (daily need)  ·  deficiencies: C→scurvy · D→rickets · B₁→beriberi · A→night blindness  ·  peptide bond –CO–NH– · levels 1°→4° (haemoglobin quaternary)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Enzymes demand narrow pH/temperature optima (human ~37 °C, specific pH per site); denaturation is usually irreversible in practice. Vitamins act in milligrams — megadoses of fat-soluble ones poison (hypervitaminosis A/D). Hormone action needs receptor specificity (lock-and-key at a distance).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Maltose (glucose+glucose) vs sucrose (glucose+fructose) vs lactose (glucose+galactose) — same atoms, different links, different digestion. Insulin (peptide hormone, 51 aa) vs thyroxine (amine, iodinated) vs steroids (lipid) — three chemical tribes, one signalling job. Zymogens (pepsinogen, trypsinogen) ship inactive, activate on site.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Why does boiling destroy enzyme activity but not vitamin C's chemistry? Heat unravels the protein's 3D active site (denaturation — structure lost, catalysis gone), while ascorbic acid's covalent bonds survive short heating (only prolonged boiling oxidises it). Structure–function reasoning answers both halves.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: 'All enzymes are proteins' has ribozyme exceptions. Vitamin labels bundle unrelated molecules (B-complex spans 8+). Hormone classifications overlap (some peptides act locally as growth factors). Denaturation reversibility depends on severity — lab renaturation ≠ kitchen reality.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Catalysis from transition-state stabilisation: the active site binds the TRANSITION state tighter than substrate (induced fit), lowering Ea without touching ΔG — hence faster arrival, same equilibrium. Michaelis–Menten (v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])) quantifies it; Lineweaver–Burk linearises Km/Vmax for the exam graph.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Vitamins: fat ADEK (stored, toxic in excess) vs water BC (daily, flushed). Deficiency chant: A-night, B1-beri, C-scurvy, D-rickets. Enzymes: specificity + efficiency + mild conditions + denaturable — four adjectives, full definition marks.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB-style: enzyme definition + lock-and-key vs induced fit; vitamin classification with two deficiency diseases; peptide bond + four protein levels; hormone types with one example each.
